decisions.decision: Removed SystemController, RSAKeys, File, TLSChannel, Database classes from the thesis class diagram
decisions.rationale: None of these exist in the codebase; the app uses a Repository pattern over Firebase SDK directly (no custom backend/DB tier, no custom TLS class)

decisions.decision: Private key modeled as device-only (FlutterSecureStorage), never an attribute of User or any Firestore-backed class
decisions.rationale: Matches actual security architecture (kill-switch / zero-remanence design) and avoids misrepresenting the crypto model to examiners

decisions.decision: Added iv field to TransferSession (was missing from original diagram)
decisions.rationale: AES-256-GCM requires the 96-bit IV alongside the wrapped AES key; omitting it was a factual error in the original diagram

decisions.decision: Added new classes: Handshake, ConnectionProposal, NotificationModel, SessionManager, SecurityLifecycleMixin, TransferService, EncryptionService (static), HandshakeRepository, CleanupRepository
decisions.rationale: These are core to the implemented architecture (RSA handshake exchange, friend-connection proposals, kill-switch state machine, zero-wipe mixin, chunked file I/O) and were entirely absent from the original diagram

decisions.decision: Mermaid is now the preferred diagram format for this thesis work going forward (sequence, activity, ERD, class diagrams)
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested Mermaid after the PlantUML version was produced; renders natively in more tools (GitHub, Obsidian, VS Code) without a PlantUML server

next_action: If user wants more diagrams (sequence/activity/ERD) for the thesis reflecting the corrected model, produce them in Mermaid format by default. Otherwise no further action needed - diagrams are complete and ready for thesis insertion.
